Shubman Gill on managing pressure: Focus on internal factors

Cricketer Shubman Gill has shared his approach to handling pressure during matches. He stated that his strategy involves consciously distancing himself from external influences and focusing on internal aspects of his game. This method helps him perform effectively in challenging situations.
